name: BeliefKV / Paul Tol semantic diagram palette

sources.use: Primary source for exact bright, light, pale, medium-contrast and dark colors.
GitHub implementation and guidance on labeled fills versus lines.
Scientific palette selection, consistent roles and redundant encoding.

scope: A semantic diagram theme combining named Tol colors, not one unmodified qualitative data series or an accessibility certification.

d2_custom_accents.d2_workflow_a_edge: Deep blue for A's solid parent and its children's pattern marks
d2_custom_accents.d2_workflow_b_edge: Deep teal for B's solid parent and its children's pattern marks
d2_custom_accents.d2_b_children: Mid teal for all three B children
d2_custom_accents.d2_hbm_edge: Steel gray for the HBM stack
d2_custom_accents.d2_host_edge: Clay brown for the Host DIMM
d2_custom_accents.d2_dma_edge: Ochre for DMA and its copy outlines
d2_custom_accents.d2_copy_fill: Gold for in-flight KV copies and the pre-JOIN interval
d2_custom_accents.d2_trigger: Dark blue for runtime triggers and inset control

derivation: For each RGB channel: round(base * (1 - white_fraction) + 255 * white_fraction). The tint recipes and custom accents are BeliefKV color choices. Exact Tol swatches are listed in exact_colors.
redundant_encoding: Agent name and persistent page ID accompany owner color.
HBM/Host have direct tier labels and fixed positions.
Data transfers use broad curved ribbons; control uses thin notched arrows.
Allocator capacity uses a grey block arrow, never a KV transfer ribbon.
Missing pages are dashed; resident pages are solid.
Execution numbers are black circles on action paths.
